query_text: Does a religion have to be old?

messages.content: Does a religion have to be old?

message.content:
No. A religion does **not** have to be old to count as a religion; age is not part of the definition of religion. Religion is generally defined by beliefs, practices, rituals, moral teachings, and a community or tradition, not by how long it has existed.[4]

If you mean “Do religions tend to be old?” then many major religions do have ancient roots, but the exact origins of early religion are hard to date, and organized religion is often traced back thousands of years.[2] If you mean “Can a new movement be a religion?” the answer is yes—new religions and modern religious movements can and do emerge over time, even though older traditions are often more established.[2][4]

If you want, I can also answer this from a legal, sociological, or philosophical angle.
